CONTAINER-ONLY slice: the pa-field items / pa-field-group title come from the separate <Field>/<FieldGroup> components and flow through this container's children slot as plain text, so only the pa-fields container's own props are mapped. noBorder maps to hasBorder with negate (hasBorder defaults true; noBorder=true -> hasBorder=false -> pa-fields--no-border). cols/color are numeric props in svelte but the dumper forwards the scenario's string token, which interpolates identically.
